collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A villager sketches a friend's face in charcoal on a smooth piece of bark.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: (subject) sketches (friend)'s face in charcoal on a smooth piece of bark. (friend) says it looks nothing like them, and everyone else says it looks exactly like them.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: (subject) sketches (friend)'s face in charcoal on a smooth piece of bark. The nose takes three tries, and the final one is the best.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: (subject) sketches (friend)'s face in charcoal on a smooth piece of bark. (friend) asks to keep it, and (subject) agrees.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: (subject) sketches (friend)'s face in charcoal on a smooth piece of bark. A smudge turns into a beard, and they both laugh.
